get.summary: Clinical Kernel API health probe.
Returns the Clinical Kernel API's operational status.
Resolves a NodeRef to its summary.
get.description: Title, code and state of one kernel object in the caller's tenant, at its current version.

get.summary: The zoom path from the tenant down to an object.
get.description: Presentation only: the path never grants or implies authority (spec §9.3).

get.summary: The children of a scope node, with their own child counts.
get.description: A node the caller may not see is refused; a child the caller may not see is masked in place (ADR-2471).

get.summary: The kernel commands offered on an object, each with the caller's dry-run decision.
get.description: Each decision is the one sending the command would get now (ADR-2483), explained (ADR-2482).

get.summary: Whether the caller may exercise a capability on an object now, and why.
get.description: A dry run: it executes nothing and is recorded in the authorization access log, not the audit chain (ADR-2483).

get.summary: Finds kernel objects in the caller's tenant by code or title.
get.description: Each word matches as a prefix; an exact code ranks first. Sources that reveal identity are searched only when the caller holds the capability (ADR-2484).

get.summary: Resolves a study code, subject code, and optional site code to pinned study and enrollment references.
get.description: Reads over the tenant's unique study and subject indexes without listing sites. Returns a non-confirming 404 when the study, site, or enrollment does not exist, mismatches, or is masked for the caller (ADR-2471).

get.summary: A study's protocol versions, newest first, without their content.
get.description: A study the caller may not see is refused; a version the caller may not see is masked in place (ADR-2471).

get.summary: One protocol version, without its content.
A protocol version's Schedule of Activities, compiled from its design.
get.description: Planned activities as columns grouped by epoch, collection specifications as rows (ADR-2475). A version the caller may not see is refused.

get.summary: Walks an object's lineage backward to its inputs or forward to its dependents.
get.description: direction is Backward (default) or Forward; depth 1 to 50 (default 10); edge_kind repeats (for example DerivedFrom); valid_at and known_at read the graph as it was.

get.summary: What depends on an object, grouped by kind with counts.
get.description: Masked objects are counted like any other, so a count never depends on the reader. depth 1 to 50 (default 10); edge_kind repeats; valid_at and known_at read the graph as it was.

get.summary: What depends on the version a protocol amendment changes (K-PROT-2).
What happened in a scope, newest first.
get.description: scope is any NodeRef (the whole tenant when absent); family repeats (Knowledge, Execution, Evidence, Trust, Quality, Intelligence); actor filters by who did it; from is the earliest recorded time; before is the previous page's next cursor; limit 1 to 200 (default 50). Entries about objects you may not see are masked in place.

get.summary: Streams a bitemporal study snapshot as CSV, CDISC ODM v1.3.2 XML, CDISC Dataset-JSON, SAS bundle ZIP, R bundle ZIP, or Study Archive ZIP.
get.description: Projects canonical kernel observations at as_of(valid_at, known_at), applying lock_filter and masking unauthorized sites or blinded treatment values in place (K-TRUTH-1, K-AUTH-4).

get.summary: Streams a participant casebook with revisions, queries, verifications, attestations and SHA-256 digests.
get.description: Streams JSON, CDISC ODM v1.3.2 XML, printable HTML, or certified PDF (%PDF-1.7) for one enrollment at as_of(valid_at, known_at), masking unauthorized or blinded content under K-AUTH-4.

post.summary: Evaluates a candidate USDM protocol version in memory without database changes.
Performs immediate real-time matrix gap check on a candidate protocol design graph.

get.summary: Lists visible studies in the caller's tenant.

post.summary: Registers a new study in the caller's tenant with a signed reason for change (study.register) and optional one-step site link.

get.summary: Lists visible organizations in the caller's tenant.

post.summary: Registers an organization such as a site institution or sponsor in the caller's tenant (organization.register).

get.summary: Lists visible investigational sites in the caller's tenant.

post.summary: Registers an investigational site under a site institution in the caller's tenant (site.register).

get.summary: Lists visible investigational sites linked to a study in the caller's tenant.

post.summary: Links an investigational site to a study in the caller's tenant (study_site.link).

get.summary: Lists bundled standard CDISC Library eCRF templates available for protocol draft import.
Returns a viewable summary of a protocol version's forms, ordered items, and import notes.

post.summary: Synchronously imports ODM v1.3.2 XML, USDM v4 JSON, or bundled eCRF templates into a protocol draft.

get.summary: An observation with its revisions, the locks covering it, the assertions about it and its kernel audit entries.

post.summary: Records an observation for the participant of an enrollment (observation.record).
Corrects an observation's value with the signed reason for change (observation.correct).
Verifies the current revision of an observation against source with the signed reason for change (observation.verify).
Retracts a verification, answer or query assertion with the signed reason for change (assertion.retract).

get.summary: Resolves a study code and subject code to its kernel enrollment state when visible to the caller (K-AUTH-4).

post.summary: Registers a pseudonymous participant when needed and starts a screening enrollment at a study site (participant.screen).
Transitions an enrollment along EnrollmentTransitions and allocates a gap-free study enrollment number on entering Enrolled (enrollment.change_status).
Verifies a 60-second single-use X-Sig-Token, records a Withdrawn attestation over the enrollment's current content hash, and withdraws the participant (participant.withdraw).
Applies a Frozen or Locked assertion to a study, study site, enrollment, form instance or observation (lock.apply).
Releases a Frozen or Locked assertion with a signed retracting assertion (lock.release).

get.summary: Lists Frozen and Locked assertions recorded for a study at an optional bitemporal as_of cut.
Evaluates lock readiness (open queries and missing required items) for a study or child lock scope.
A study's proposals, newest first, optionally only those with one status (Open, Approved, Rejected, Withdrawn, Expired).
get.description: A study the caller may not see is refused; a proposal the caller may not see is masked in place (ADR-2471).

get.summary: One proposal with its intent, plan, affected objects, requested capabilities, model, content hash and decision.

post.summary: Rejects an open proposal; the signed reason for change is the rejection reason (proposal.reject).

get.summary: Lists rule-pack library items in the tenant and indicates which versions are pinned on the study.

post.summary: Evaluates a draft or approved rule pack in memory over the study's current collection records without mutating state.
Approves a draft library item version with an Approved attestation (library_item.approve).

put.summary: Declares or updates the approved rule-pack library items pinned on a study (study.declare_standards).

get.summary: Lists derived validation findings for a study, optionally filtered by stage, status, severity, rule pack or dataset.
Returns one derived validation finding and its structured provenance explanation.
The caller's tenant commercial subscription tier, trial state, and enabled product families.
get.description: Requires an enrolled TenantMembership and an active Grant visible via GrantNodeVisibility. BillingConfirmation is masked unless the caller holds billing permission. Commercial packaging boundary: never grants clinical study access or bypasses Grant, blinding, or consent.

get.summary: Minimal internal tenant commercial posture for the API gateway.
get.description: Restricted to svc:gateway-entitlements. Returns read-only state, enabled product families, and quantitative scoping caps while omitting BillingConfirmation.

post.summary: Switches the tenant's commercial evaluation tier in place while preserving trial countdown and clinical records.
post.description: Requires caller Idempotency-Key and signed X-Change-Reason headers. Updates enabled product families on an active Trialing or Active subscription in one atomic transaction without activating billing or extending the original 30-day trial window.

post.summary: Activates a Trialing or Expired commercial subscription after validating study scoping and a verified quote token.
post.description: Requires caller Idempotency-Key and signed X-Change-Reason headers, study scoping parameters, and a verified cryptographic commercial quote token (or CommercialOperators.BillingOperator) before transitioning a Trialing or Expired workspace to Active in one atomic transaction.

post.summary: Provisions an isolated self-service trial workspace for an unbound authenticated OIDC caller.
post.description: Mapped outside KernelTenantFilter for signed-in callers without an active tenant_id claim, study/site scope, or clinical realm roles. Requires caller Idempotency-Key and signed X-Change-Reason headers.

post.summary: Match a command-palette query against fixed patterns and return the navigation targets the caller's roles allow.

get.summary: The caller's latest agent runs from the interaction ledger, newest first.
One of the caller's agent runs with its request, answer, usage and integrity hash.
The agent task configuration versions in this deployment, with their content hashes and the tenant's qualification of each.

post.summary: Stores an evaluation run record after checking it against its task configuration version, set, criteria and case results (evaluation_run.record, ADR-2634).

get.summary: One stored evaluation run with its record, exactly as hashed.
The stored evaluation runs of a task, newest first, optionally of one version.

post.summary: Qualifies a task configuration version on a stored, accepted evaluation run and the caller's signed approval (task_configuration.qualify, ADR-2631).
Takes a qualified task configuration version out of use until it is qualified again (task_configuration.suspend).

get.summary: The tenant's AI kill switches and monthly token budgets.

put.summary: Switches agents on or off for every task ('*') or one task, and sets the monthly token budget (agent_control.set).

post.summary: Tests video frame payloads for anti-spoofing in temporary memory and returns signed liveness tokens.

get.summary: Lists the forms opened for an enrollment, oldest first.

post.summary: Opens a form for a participant's visit under the protocol version in force (collection.open).

get.summary: Reads a form: its items in layout order with their values, completeness, locks, assertions and signatures.

put.summary: Saves a page of values: all of them or, on one stale revision or invalid value, none (collection.record).

post.summary: Evaluates pinned study collection rules in memory over draft form values without mutating state (K-RULE-3).

get.summary: Lists the queries on every form of an enrollment or across visible enrollments of a study, oldest first.
Lists daily de-identified query aging digests for visible scopes of a study.

post.summary: Escalates open queries past their 14-day SLA on IClock and emits daily aging digests (execution.query.manage).

422.description: Unprocessable Entity. Kernel errors: `K.Command.IdempotencyKeyRequired`, `K.Command.Invalid`, `K.Command.ReasonForChangeRequired`, `K.Command.TenantRequired`. Kernel errors: `K.Command.IdempotencyKeyRequired`, `K.Command.Invalid`, `K.Command.ReasonForChangeRequired`, `K.Command.TenantRequired`.

get.summary: Lists a form's queries, oldest first, each with whether its value changed since it was raised.

post.summary: Raises a query on the current revision of one of the form's values or on a blank item (execution.query.raise).

404.description: Not Found. Kernel errors: `K.Aggregate.NotFound`. Kernel errors: `M.Execution.Form.CollectionInstanceUnknown`, `M.Execution.Query.ObservationUnknown`.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity. Kernel errors: `K.Collection.ValuesInvalid`, `K.Command.IdempotencyKeyRequired`, `K.Command.Invalid`, `K.Command.ReasonForChangeRequired`, `K.Command.TenantRequired`. Kernel errors: `K.Command.IdempotencyKeyRequired`, `K.Command.Invalid`, `K.Command.ReasonForChangeRequired`, `K.Command.TenantRequired`.

post.summary: Answers an open query (execution.query.answer).
Reopens an answered or closed query with why it is not settled (execution.query.manage).
Closes an answered manual query (separation of duties) or system query (execution.query.manage).
Cancels an open or answered query raised in error (execution.query.manage).
Signs the form's current values with an X-Sig-Token step-up token (collection.sign); 409 when the form changed since it was read.
